What matters to us

The spirit of cricketThe spirit of cricketThe spirit of cricket

A team is built through the way it plays, works together, and treats everyone around the game.

  • 01

    Love of the game

    Cricket rewards patience, focus, and the courage to play the next ball well.

  • 02

    Team before self

    Every role matters. We value the effort each player brings to the side.

  • 03

    Respect all around

    The spirit of cricket means showing respect to teammates, opponents, and supporters.

A shared love of cricket

Play hard. Back your team. Enjoy the game.

Cricket is built on skill and strategy, but it is the people beside you that make it memorable. PNW Rhinos celebrates the energy, effort, and togetherness that make the game special.

More about the Rhinos

On and off the field

A good team makes room for everyone.

Whether you play, follow, or simply love cricket, there is always something to appreciate in the game and its community.

  • 01Teamwork

    Trust the people beside you and celebrate the effort they bring.

  • 02Sportsmanship

    Compete with pride and respect everyone who shares the field.

  • 03Community

    Keep cricket welcoming, connected, and part of the Pacific Northwest.
